name: Shiramine Masumi
source:
The mother of a male student whom the protagonist is homeroom teacher.
She is proud and vain.

She loves her family in her own way, and she wants her son to go to a good university.

She asks the protagonist for advice on how to get a recommendation for college, but he takes advantage of her and...!
